coding.system_prompt: Solve the Python programming task. Return exactly one nonempty ```python code block, with no surrounding prose. Include necessary imports. You have one answer and receive no execution feedback.
coding.user_prompt:
{{ instruction }}

Return the complete Python implementation of {{ function_name }}. The evaluator will write your code to the implementation file and test separate inputs.

rules.coding_preservation: nonnegative paired success difference in every confirmation seed
rules.scene_evidence: reviewed real observation followed by a state-dependent implementation; independent grading required
rules.qualification: complete comparable confirmation, preserved coding, no confirmed class regression, positive overall task gain and reviewed workspace gain
rules.ranking: most Harness successes across the fixed three seeds; ties prefer fewer optimizer updates
rules.recovery: model-specific failure cohorts are descriptive only; no controlled recovery claim
rules.seed_dependence: aggregate paired differences within task family; seeds and variants are not independent tasks
rules.efficiency: diagnostic only; no efficiency threshold or loss-based selection
